failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Shakespeare Twelfth Night alternative title "What You Will"' retrieved documents confirming the claim. Hop 3 query: 'What is the full title of Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night" and what alternative titles or naming conventions is this play known by?' retrieved identical documents to hop 2 (all passages from hop 2 reappear in hop 3: Twelfth Night 1955 film, 1996 film, 1988 film, Malvolio, and the main Twelfth Night article). The query rewording did not advance information gathering; the same evidence was re-fetched.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query: 'What is the full title of Shakespeare's "Twelfth Night" and what alternative titles or naming conventions is this play known by?' is formulated as a natural-language question rather than a keyword-based retrieval query, which is suboptimal for document retrieval systems.
